title: Iran on the Brink: Goldie Ghamari Predicts Historic Uprising for Freedom
desc: Goldie Ghamari, an Iranian-born ex-Canadian lawmaker, foresees a 'biggest uprising' in Iran following Supreme Leader Khamenei's death. She claims the nation is close to freedom and predicts a secular democratic state. Ghamari dismisses regime supporters as a minority and questions reports of a deadly strike.
